gloss: collection of famous sayings; book of quotations

definitions.gloss: collection of famous sayings; book of quotations; anthology of notable quotes
definitions.explanation: A compiled collection of memorable or wise sayings from famous people. Available as books, websites, or social media content.

examples.japanese: {名言集|めいげんしゅう}を{読|よ}むのが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like reading collections of famous quotes.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}のスピーチに{使|つか}えそうな{名言集|めいげんしゅう}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a quote collection that might be useful for a graduation speech.

examples.japanese: この{名言集|めいげんしゅう}には、{歴史上|れきしじょう}の{偉人|いじん}たちの{言葉|ことば}が{収|おさ}められている。
examples.english: This collection contains the words of great historical figures.

notes:
Compound of {名言|めいげん} (famous saying; wise words) + {集|しゅう} (collection; compilation). A common book genre and popular content category online.

THE ～{集|しゅう} PATTERN:
- {詩集|ししゅう}: poetry collection
- {句集|くしゅう}: haiku collection
- {短編集|たんぺんしゅう}: short story collection
- {写真集|しゃしんしゅう}: photo book
- {作品集|さくひんしゅう}: collected works

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名言集|めいげんしゅう}を{編|あ}む: to compile a collection of quotes
- {名言集|めいげんしゅう}から{引用|いんよう}する: to quote from a book of quotations
- {偉人|いじん}の{名言集|めいげんしゅう}: quotes from great people

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {格言集|かくげんしゅう}: collection of maxims — more focused on moral or practical proverbs
- {語録|ごろく}: collected sayings — often the sayings of one specific person
